target_customer: Finance and operations teams at B2B SaaS and usage based companies that pay sales commissions
problem: Modern sales compensation plans tied to product led sales and usage pricing do not fit older tools, so companies fall back on spreadsheets or BI tools to compute commissions.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for commission calculation and sales performance

founders.name: Jean-Edern Lorillon
founders.background_notes: YC page: about six years in SaaS and helped grow Algolia from 200 to 8,500 customers. Education not stated on the YC page.

competitors.name: CaptivateIQ
competitors.what: Commission automation platform for mid sized tech sales teams
competitors.funding_then: $46M Series B in 2021-04 per Multiples.vc and PitchBook (aggregators)

competitors.name: Spiff
competitors.what: Commission software that replaced manual spreadsheet commission processes

competitors.name: Xactly
competitors.what: Incumbent enterprise sales compensation software named by the CEO as a competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs connectors to CRMs, accounting tools and ERPs and a flexible plan rules engine, standard engineering with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Once commission plans and integrations are configured, switching is painful, but well funded rivals already served the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce Ventures led Spiff's $50M Series C in 2023 per press; no source found about an incumbent buying PaletteHQ.

market_need_then: The founder said in 2022 that none of the tools evaluated handled modern plans for product led sales and consumption pricing, and TechCrunch notes many firms still use spreadsheets.

branding.domain_note: Uses palettehq.com, with an HQ suffix because the plain name is shared by many products.

identity.voice_and_tone: Approachable; non technical teams can implement it in a day (YC page)

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated products are also called Palette, and no press or community coverage of the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: PaletteHQ raised a $6M seed in 2022-05 from Bain Capital Ventures and others, about nine months after the batch, and remains active. It entered a category where CaptivateIQ and Spiff each raised $46M Series B rounds in 2021, so it must win on modern usage based plans. The founder came from Algolia's sales team. No later rounds or exit were found.
